headline: Mosaic Swings to $72 Million Third-Quarter Loss
summary: Mosaic reported a net loss of $72 million for the third quarter, reversing a profit of $411 million recorded in the same period last year.
why: Mosaic is a major global producer of concentrated phosphate and potash crop nutrients, serving as an indicator for agricultural input markets.

impacts.name: Mosaic
impacts.why: Swinging from a net profit to a net loss directly reflects weaker financial performance for the fertilizer producer.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A severe reversal into a net loss compared to the prior year weighed negatively on the company's financial profile.
